scope: Bound the MPOLYGON DXF group-63 ACI color at parser, typed-model validation and writer admission boundaries.

sourceWitness.parser: DRW_MPolygon::parseCode currently stores any int32 group-63 value without validation.
sourceWitness.typedValidation: DRW_MPolygon::validateDxf checks color CMC shape only when DWG CMC metadata is present; a plain DXF ACI value has no domain check.
sourceWitness.writerAdmission: dxfRW::preflightEntity permits group-63 values through UINT16_MAX; writeMPolygon emits the value through writeInt16.
sourceWitness.autodeskDxfDefinition: The Autodesk DXF reference defines group 63 for MPOLYGON as the pattern fill color in ACI.
sourceWitness.autodeskColorDomain: Autodesk AcCmColor::setColorIndex accepts 0 through 256; 0 means BYBLOCK and 256 means BYLAYER, while 1 through 255 are indexed ACI colors.

implementationBrief.domain: Accept group-63 ACI color values from 0 through 256, including the documented BYBLOCK and BYLAYER special indices; reject negative values and values above 256 before mutating the model or publishing output.
implementationBrief.writerRule: Apply the same 0..256 bound in typed validation and entity preflight so writeInt16 cannot receive out-of-domain values.
implementationBrief.tests: Generated parser vectors cover -1, 0, 1, 255, 256, and 257 with state preservation and corrected same-group retry. ASCII/Binary writer tests cover invalid refusal, destination preservation, valid 256 readback, and same-adapter retry.
implementationBrief.doNotInfer: This scalar domain check does not qualify MPOLYGON fill rendering, physical producer breadth, or whole-file/native semantic support.

validationPlan: Run the owning MPOLYGON ACI selector and affected MPOLYGON/HATCH cohort.
Run git diff --check and verify no sample fixtures were added.

verifiedBehavior: Parser rejects -1 and 257 without changing the existing ACI field, then accepts corrected value 256.
Parser accepts the documented domain endpoints and representatives 0, 1, 255, and 256.
ASCII and Binary typed writers reject -1 and 257 while preserving pre-existing destination bytes, then the same adapter writes 256 and typed readback returns 256.
Focused MPOLYGON/HATCH cohort passes, including existing CMC and boundary metadata coverage.

fixtures.testInput: Locally generated in-memory DXF groups and temporary writer outputs removed after the selector.

repositoryState.inputSnapshot: staged blobs composed from HEAD plus MPOLYGON ACI-only changes; owning fast test ran against corresponding worktree source
